subject: Media Literacy
title: Source Protection and Confidentiality
description: A quick win: understand Source Protection and Confidentiality.

hook.text: A journalist goes to jail rather than reveal her source. The whistleblower exposed government fraud. The court demands the name.

buildup.text: Source protection means journalists keep confidential sources anonymous, even under legal pressure.

discovery.text: Without this protection, whistleblowers would never come forward. Critical stories about corruption would never be told.

twist.text: Source protection isn't legally guaranteed everywhere. Some journalists have served prison time to protect their sources.

climax.text: The promise of confidentiality is sacred in journalism. Breaking it once destroys trust with every future source.

punchline.text: A journalist's promise to a source is the foundation of all investigative reporting.

quiz.question: Why is source protection important in journalism?
options: Without it, whistleblowers wouldn't come forward and corruption would go unexposed
It's just a tradition with no real purpose
